comment: Read from the maker's source at 2.6.1, commit e6a0c67. Particles::process does nothing but drive one lamp; every control is read by ParticlesWidget::step, which draws the animation, so no voltage ranges could be established from the audio thread and none are quoted. The sixteen particle names are read from Particles::Particles. The module has no output ports at all, so it has no family map. The source gives the ranges the panel does not: the five knob CVs add a tenth of the control per volt and are clamped with the knob, and the on/off jack toggles on a rising edge through 1V.
